proposed_experiments.name: Logistic Regression Baseline Audit
proposed_experiments.description: Run calibrated LR (sigmoid + isotonic) on our current 3290 feature candidates. If LR alone hits Brier < 0.22, this validates that our tree models are overfitting relative to LR baseline.
proposed_experiments.implementation: In evaluation island, add LogisticRegression(C=0.1, max_iter=500) as a model_type option in the GA. Let evolution discover which features work best with LR.
proposed_experiments.effort: LOW — add 1 model type to model_types list in evolution config
proposed_experiments.file_to_modify: hf-space/app.py or evolution/genetic_loop.py — add 'logistic' to model_types

proposed_experiments.name: Post-hoc Isotonic Calibration
proposed_experiments.description: After GA selects best features+model, apply sklearn CalibratedClassifierCV with isotonic regression to final model. Compare Brier before/after calibration.
proposed_experiments.implementation: In predict_today.py and eval pipeline, wrap best model with CalibratedClassifierCV(method='isotonic', cv=5). Track calibration_brier vs raw_brier in Supabase.
proposed_experiments.effort: LOW — 5 lines of code in calibration/ module

proposed_experiments.name: Era Normalization for Season Fixed Effects
proposed_experiments.description: Per-100-possession normalization already exists. Add season_era feature: 3PT_rate_vs_league_season_avg to capture style drift. Pace has changed dramatically 2010-2026.
proposed_experiments.implementation: Add ~10 era-normalized features to engine.py category 55 (or existing pace_adjusted_features.py). Normalize each stat by that season's league average.
proposed_experiments.effort: MEDIUM — add ~15 features to existing pace_adjusted_features.py

proposed_experiments.name: MC Dropout Uncertainty Features as Meta-Features
proposed_experiments.description: Run LightGBM 100x with 10% feature dropout. Compute mean prediction, std, and confidence interval. Use (mean, std) as 2 additional meta-features in next GA layer.
proposed_experiments.implementation: Adapt existing meta2_ calibration features (already in engine). Add mc_dropout_mean, mc_dropout_std, mc_dropout_ci_width using random feature subsampling.
proposed_experiments.effort: MEDIUM — extend meta_features section in engine.py

quick_win.reason: 5 lines of code, proven -0.003 to -0.008 gain in paper, directly applicable to existing predict_today.py. No training needed — post-hoc only.
implementation_steps: 1. In calibration/conformal.py, add: from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
2. Wrap best GA model: cal_model = CalibratedClassifierCV(best_model, method='isotonic', cv=5).fit(X_val, y_val)
3. Use cal_model.predict_proba() in predict_today.py instead of raw model
4. Log calibration_brier to Supabase alongside raw_brier
5. If calibrated_brier < raw_brier: use calibrated model for predictions

cross_project_applicability.political_alpha: Same isotonic calibration applies to political_engine.py. PA2's Brier=0.218 could potentially reach 0.210 with proper calibration.
cross_project_applicability.both_projects: Fractional Kelly 0.3x staking rule from paper should replace any full-Kelly calculations in bankroll_manager.py
